chunks.title: GFANZ / Catalytic Capital Repository (GCBC) (GFANZ Catalytic Capital) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: GFANZ / Catalytic Capital Repository (GCBC) is a Institutional / Catalytic / Climate PE headquartered in United Kingdom / Global Coalition. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Launched 'Catalytic Capital Repository' (30+ financial institutions) at COP31 Nov 11–12; partnered with Türkiye Ministry of Industry & Technology on industrial decarbonization; co-hosted Global Finance Summit. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Public repository of 30+ catalytic capital & risk-mitigation providers for EMDE clean energy/resilience + Türkiye industrial decarbonization private-capital partnership. Source verification: https://www.esgdive.com/news/platform-launched-at-cop31-aims-to-scale-transition-capital-in-emerging-mar/874527/.

chunks.title: GFANZ Catalytic Capital Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: GFANZ / Catalytic Capital Repository (GCBC) provides the following climate financing instruments: Catalytic First-Loss Capital, Risk-Mitigation Guarantee, Blended Transition Facility, Co-Investment Syndication. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 200,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Project SPV, Large Corporate, Financial Intermediary, Fund Manager, Climate-Tech Startup.

chunks.title: GFANZ Catalytic Capital Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by GFANZ / Catalytic Capital Repository (GCBC): Industrial Decarbonization, Renewable Energy, Electrification & Grid, Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Energy Storage. Target geographic focus includes: Emerging Markets, Developing Countries, Türkiye, Africa, Asia, Latin America, Global. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: GFANZ Catalytic Capital Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete GFANZ Catalytic Capital's application form: Clear private-capital mobilization & de-risking thesis (EMDEs); Alignment with GFANZ Transition Finance guidelines; Defined blended capital stack showing catalytic layer role; Quantified GHG avoidance or climate resilience impact. Explicit exclusion rules: Unabated coal expansion; Non-catalytic purely commercial subsidies without additionality. Official application portal: https://www.gfanzero.com/.

chunks.title: GFANZ Catalytic Capital Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: GFANZ / Catalytic Capital Repository (GCBC) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
